subject: infra.connect
name: Starlink market authorisation
what_would_settle_it: An ARPT licensing decision, a published authorisation register, or a ministerial statement on Starlink market entry.

subject: gov.discourse
name: Official explanation of the social-media restriction
what_would_settle_it: Any published legal basis, ARPT decision or ministerial statement acknowledging the restriction on Facebook, YouTube and TikTok.

subject: finance.budget
name: Domestic budget appropriation for digital transformation
what_would_settle_it: The Loi de finances or its annexes showing appropriation lines for MCENI, ANDE, ANSSI or the Digital Sovereignty Fund.

subject: dpi.registry
name: Address register
what_would_settle_it: A national addressing instrument, a published address database or coverage figure, or the outcome of the digital addressing tender opened in November 2025.

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Artificial intelligence in the administration
what_would_settle_it: Any instrument governing or authorising AI use inside the administration, or a named system in production in a ministry.
